excluded.reason: A build artifact, not a second document: the byte-identical copy of docs/reference/documentation-application.md that a project build writes into the build directory because declared outputs resolve against it (ADR-012 §1 addition 2, from the B1 spike's finding 6). ADR-012 records those copies as committed with the build and never linked, never read and never hand-edited, so cataloging it would put a duplicate into every reader-facing map of the corpus. It stops existing if the docs_output_dir key of ADR-012 §2.4 is ever adopted.
Test data, not documentation: a golden file whose exact bytes the documentation emitter's tests assert against. Nobody reads it, and editing it for a reader would break the test that owns it.
Test data, not documentation: a golden file whose exact bytes the documentation emitter's tests assert against. Nobody reads it, and editing it for a reader would break the test that owns it.
Test data, not documentation: the explanatory file inside a fixture project the layout-migration tests build on. It describes the fixture to whoever maintains the test, and it ships to nobody.
